Subject: Post-call: Commercial route checklist + econ sponsor spotlight (Greenline)

Hi Emma — thanks for the 30-minute call earlier. Quick recap and a short checklist to help us qualify the commercial path so we can prioritize next steps on our side.

Key takeaways from the call:
- You're evaluating RLHF-driven assistant for customer support (pilot scope: 25 agents, 50k tokens/day).
- Procurement is flexible but prefers PO for anything > $25k/year; smaller purchases via card or marketplace are acceptable.
- Marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) is interesting if we can provide metered billing and a short-term trial.
- Economic buyer: Sanjay (VP Ops) is the primary budget owner; Finance sponsor is typically procurement@greenline.com.

Quick qualification checklist for your team (attached as PDF):
1) Preferred payment method (PO vs. card vs marketplace) and threshold for PO sign-off.
2) Standard signatory roster: who needs to sign (Sanjay + Finance Director?)
3) Preferred contract template (your SOW or our standard MSA + order form).
4) Any org-level compliance requirements (SOC2, data retention windows, logging).

Can you confirm (1) whether Sanjay is the final approver for pilot spend, and (2) whether Greenline would prefer a marketplace trial or a direct PO for an initial 3-month pilot?

If it's easier, I can draft a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) that captures decision owners and timelines — I can share that with your procurement contact.

Thanks again — I put Karthik and Ben on cc to help with pricing/marketplace details.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

I'll ask procurement to share the vendor questionnaire today. For contract owners: Sanjay + our legal ops (cc'd) will review the MSA — but Sanjay will drive the final buy decision.

Thanks, all. Quick answers from the product/commercial side: 

1) Marketplace: We can spin up a metered 30-day trial via AWS Marketplace. Requirements: active marketplace listing (we have it), metering hook enabled, and a short usage cap to prevent runaway spend. I'll coordinate with Marketplace ops to provision a test SKU for Greenline.

2) PO vs Card: For the pilot (estimated $8k-18k for 3 months depending on tokens), card payment works fine. If they want to lock commitment > $25k/year, a PO is typical. We can provide an order form that sits on our standard MSA and supports PO reference numbers for their finance team.

3) Signatory path: Based on Emma's note, Sanjay signs for approval; legal ops will counter-sign MSA if any redlines. If they insist on vendor onboarding paperwork, we can supply SOC2 report, standard SLAs, and an export/data retention appendix.

Action items I will take:
- Create a provisional MAP template with owners and a pricing band for the 3-month pilot (EOD tomorrow).
- Ask Marketplace ops to provision a metered trial SKU and share a test link.
- Put together the minimal evidence packet (SOC2 attestation, IP/DTAs) for procurement.

I'll attach the pricing band and the MAP in a follow-up. Ben, can you double-check invoicing lead times for PO payment (net30 vs net45)?

Thanks,
